scope: Overview QC pass count now deduplicates TIDs across the selected date range, matching acceptance flow counters and group table.

behavior.events: qc_pass only; include any pass date in the selected interval, then Set of current projected TID.
behavior.example: A TID passed on two different days counts once on each individual day and once across the combined range.
behavior.annotation: Unchanged: first effective submission only; rework does not increase initial completion.
behavior.unchanged: Acceptance counters, first QC/acceptance accuracy, rejection counts, volume counts, workflow, daily rows/exports, API and business data.
behavior.cache: Add qcPassDates to existing bounded review-facts cache; date changes reuse facts; snapshot and role changes invalidate.

deployment.rollback: Restore backed-up index with candidate SHA guard; keep versioned assets.
